_comment: SEED lab-group profiles that ship with this install. Users can also create their own profiles in the web UI (＋ New lab profile), stored per-browser. Leave 'profiles' empty ([]) to ship blank — the UI then greets first-run users with a 'create your first profile' screen. Each seed profile scopes the sidebar to the tracks that group uses: give it a unique id, a name/blurb, and list its track ids. Optional 'image' = a logo (a filename in upstream/static/, or a full https URL). Valid track ids: qc, genomics, rnaseq, atacseq, chipseq, methylation, proteomics, download. Use ["*"] for every track. Navigation only — it never restricts the CLI.
